completeCard.name: Nature's Whisper
completeCard.effect:
Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

KEEP generic nonspell Ready: this Action-time technique may be readied through the current Ready procedure. Ready setup spends its Action and records one perceivable trigger; it does not activate Nature's Whisper, pay its RP/feat use, start its Recharge, start its minute, update spell history or create held-spell concentration. On a legal release before Ready expires, spend the required permitted Reaction and perform the actual activation commitment instead of another Action; recheck its own entitlement, recharge, personal RP, terrain and, for borrowing, the prepared donor/signal conditions at that release. An invalid or declined trigger spends no release resource and may await another valid trigger within the same Ready window. Unreleased, replaced or expired Ready loses its setup Action but not an unspent Nature/feat cost. A legally released then interrupted activation retains all committed costs and Recharge. Native and borrowed copies use the actor's same source-ID recharge history; borrowing does not refresh it or the donor's history. Recharge 3 ticks once at each subsequent owner regular-turn start, or once per six elapsed seconds outside initiative without double counting; extra Actions and extra turns do not tick it. A recharge becoming ready grants no new borrowed feat use.

source.originalText: Nature's Whisper: Cast a minor nature spell that reveals hidden creatures or tracks within a small area.

rangerDrift.historicalEffect: Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.
rangerDrift.interpretation: Current NWQ nonspell classification and activation/rider procedure supersede the shorter historical comparison text.

issues.title: Wizard Dispel Magic is a distinct class spell
issues.requiredReview: Wizard class Dispel is Action3RP/60ft/Recharge2/rank3, automatic through3 and INT+PB against10+rank above3. Do not replace this with the proposed Greater Dispel10+2rank procedure or ordinary same-name payload. Sigil Authority explicitly names Counterspell and Dispel Magic checks; do not silently extend its+1 to Greater Dispel solely because both end spells.

issues.title: Nature's Whisper current classification
issues.requiredReview: The old AC5 Ranger envelope predates accepted NWQ. Current Nature's Whisper is magical NONSPELL, spellRank:null, Action1RP/Recharge3, no ordinary spell components/counter window/rank cadence, and has exact suppression and Ready rules. Lesser Antimagic may interact only through a genuinely applicable magical-technique scope; Greater Dispel needs an actual nonspell dispel interface. Nexus/Dampening do not apply merely because it costs1RP.

issues.title: Intrinsic Oracle condition protection
issues.requiredReview: Oracle's Burden expressly prevents generic remove/suspend and requires a feature naming the Oracle Curse. Do not let broad magic language suppress the entire Curse. Manifestation prevents normally voluntary Curse suppression for its3rounds; Tongues and Consumed retain their own expressly named suppression permissions and limits. Decide specific effects from the actual cards, not a blanket class erasure.

issues.title: Spell-save defenses remain distinct
issues.requiredReview: Shaman Spell Resistance already grants advantage against actual spells; the ordinary rank5ward cannot stack another advantage. Thief Arcane Resistance grants+2spell saves, not damage resistance. Druid Nature's Ward immunity covers Charmed/Frightened from fey/elementals plus its printed poison/disease scope, not every ability of those types or every planar removal.

issues.title: Mage price and penetration scope
issues.requiredReview: Arcane Bypass ignores actual printed damage-type resistance for one declared damaging Mage spell, not immunity, antimagic, walls or endpoint blockers. Spell Efficiency needs prior real Focus-eligible cast and next differently named same-current-element eligible spell, min1, with actual exclusions. Use that predicate before the new Nexus/Dampening/Influence stages; no automatic eligibility for every Conjuration spell.

issues.title: Limited theft and suppression are not universal dispels
issues.requiredReview: Preserve each trigger, save, rank cap and selected payload. Arcane Theft only temporary rank1–3buffs and printed AC/Speed/one resistance; it cannot take rank5Spell Resistance, prevention pools, summons or resources. Shattershot distinguishes shield equipmentAC from one visible rank1–3magical defense. Spell Disruptor affects observed temporary magical+AC maximum2; Resonance Barrier is not+AC merely because named shield/barrier.

issues.title: Device abilities are not antimagic by title
issues.requiredReview: Overload Suppression targets construct/device and applies its next-Reaction/attack-disadvantage/Stunned failure-by5 clauses, with shared hard-control guard. Malfunction Field imposes disadvantage on the first qualifying spell attack, once/round total; it leaves save-based areas unchanged and explicitly creates no antimagic zone.

issues.title: Paladin aura and word do not share one suppression scope
issues.requiredReview: The aura uses a target-start CHA save and one Director-selected temporary beneficial non-innate magical effect, never immunities/class engines/permanent traits/attunement. The Blasphemous Word uses an Action2RP, CON and damage plus one temporary beneficial spell or regeneration effect. Keep these predicates distinct in ward/summon suppression examples.

issues.title: Release and transfer apply only their printed components
issues.requiredReview: Liberating Smite/Break Bonds operate on their actual Grappled/Restrained predicates and source release permissions, not generic Planar Binding service or Banishment. Crownshatter transfers temporary+1/+2numerical AC/attack/save bonuses only; it cannot move Spell Resistance advantage, Resonance Barrier prevention, immunity, resources or a class engine.

issues.title: Protected books and radiant conversions
issues.requiredReview: Spell Preservation protects against permanent destruction/erasure but explicitly permits suppression; a field does not destroy or duplicate the book. Cosmic Equilibrium converts actual eligible excess healing/radiant damage under two once/round pools which cannot trigger each other. Fire aura damage and prevented Barrier damage do not become qualifying Cleric radiant damage or actual damage dealt.

additionalExamples.title: Wizard class and ordinary dispels
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Use a real rank7 ongoing source. Class Dispel DC17 with INT4+PB4 and die10 totals18: success. Proposed Greater Dispel DC24 with the same modifiers and die15 totals23: failure unless its own reviewed rule changes. Record Action/RP/recharge separately and do not automatically add Sigil Authority to Greater Dispel.

additionalExamples.title: Nature's Whisper in a field
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Actual Ranger with personalRP5 uses lawful Nature's Whisper inside Nexus plus Dampening: it remains a nonspell technique with its own1RP/recharge rules. Separately apply eligible antimagic suppression to the same technique without granting ordinary Counterspell or a guessed spell rank.

additionalExamples.title: Oracle exact protection
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Oracle2+ with Burden and selected Tongues enters Lesser Antimagic while Curse Manifestation is active. Decide only source-permitted specific suppression; no generic removal of intrinsic Curse or its protected drawbacks.

additionalExamples.title: Different save defenses
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A Shaman Bloodcaller with its actual passive receives ordinary Spell Resistance: one advantage only. Separately a Thief with Arcane Resistance receives the ward: apply one advantage plus its actual+2spell-save modifier under existing bonus rules; generic concentration saves do not acquire spell-save provenance.

additionalExamples.title: Theft and prevention
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A Thief attempts Arcane Theft against rank5Spell Resistance, then Spell Disruptor against a Resonance Barrier prevention pool. Both fail the respective rank/payload predicate; neither becomes an AC bonus from a name.

additionalExamples.title: Tinker versus save area
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A caster under a real Malfunction Field uses proposed Massive Elemental Blast, which resolves via target DEX saves. No spell attack exists for the device's disadvantage to affect.

additionalExamples.title: Paladin release versus service
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A target is subject to Planar Binding service but is neither Grappled nor Restrained. Break Bonds and Liberating Smite do not automatically end that unrelated binding record. A separately sourced actual restraint uses its own release branch.

additionalExamples.title: Aura and word suppression
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Use actual Inferno Paladin cards69and70 against a recipient with temporary Spell Resistance and a distinct intrinsic immunity. Respect each save/timing/eligibility and never suppress the immunity via the aura.
